title: Dataset Management & Loading
summary: This module provides tools for loading, processing, and managing various datasets for DSPy programs, including specialized datasets like AlfWorld, GSM8K, and MATH, and utilities for data splitting and sampling.

nodes.label: Load & Process Data
nodes.title: DataLoader
nodes.description: Provides methods to load datasets from various sources like Hugging Face, CSV, JSON, Parquet, Pandas DataFrames, and DSPy Retrieval Modules, converting them into DSPy Example objects.

nodes.label: Manage Dataset Splits
nodes.title: Dataset
nodes.description: A base class for managing dataset splits (train, dev, test), handling shuffling, sampling, and converting raw data into DSPy Example objects with unique identifiers.

nodes.label: AlfWorld Task Dataset
nodes.title: AlfWorld
nodes.description: Initializes and manages the AlfWorld dataset, preparing examples for interaction with the AlfWorld text-based game environment.

nodes.label: Interact with AlfWorld Env
nodes.title: env_worker
nodes.description: A dedicated process for interacting with the AlfWorld environment, handling initialization and step-by-step actions.

nodes.label: GSM8K Math Dataset
nodes.title: GSM8K
nodes.description: Loads and processes the GSM8K dataset of grade school math word problems, extracting questions, gold reasoning, and answers into DSPy Example format.

nodes.label: Evaluate GSM8K Answers
nodes.title: gsm8k_metric
nodes.description: Evaluates the correctness of predicted answers for GSM8K problems by parsing integer values and comparing them to gold answers.

nodes.label: MATH Problem Dataset
nodes.title: MATH
nodes.description: Loads and processes the MATH dataset, extracting problems, solutions, and answers, and provides a metric for evaluating mathematical equivalence.

nodes.label: DSPy Example Object
nodes.title: dspy.Example
nodes.description: The fundamental data structure in DSPy, representing a single input-output example used for training, development, and evaluation.

nodes.label: HuggingFace Datasets Hub
nodes.title: HuggingFace Datasets
nodes.description: An external library and hub providing access to a vast collection of public datasets.

nodes.label: Pandas DataFrames
nodes.title: pd.DataFrame
nodes.description: A widely used Python library for data manipulation and analysis, often used as an input format for data loading.

nodes.label: Local Data Files (CSV, JSON, Parquet)
nodes.title: Local Files
nodes.description: Represents various local file formats (CSV, JSON, Parquet) that can be loaded as datasets.

nodes.label: DSPy Retrieval Module
nodes.title: dspy.settings.rm
nodes.description: A DSPy component responsible for retrieving relevant information or examples from a knowledge base.

nodes.label: AlfWorld Game Environment
nodes.title: AlfredTWEnv
nodes.description: The external interactive text-based game environment for the AlfWorld task.

nodes.label: Math Equivalence Library
nodes.title: math_equivalence
nodes.description: An external Python library specifically designed for evaluating mathematical expressions and checking equivalence.

groups.label: Data Loading & Preparation
groups.title: Core Data Utilities
groups.description: Components responsible for loading data from various sources and preparing it for use within DSPy, including managing dataset splits.

groups.label: Specialized Task Datasets
groups.title: Pre-packaged Datasets
groups.description: Specific dataset implementations for common benchmarks and tasks like AlfWorld, GSM8K, and MATH.

groups.label: AlfWorld Environment Integration
groups.title: AlfWorld Interaction
groups.description: Handles the interaction logic with the external AlfWorld game environment.

groups.label: Evaluation Metrics
groups.title: Dataset-Specific Metrics
groups.description: Functions designed to evaluate the performance of models on specific datasets.

groups.label: External Data Sources
groups.title: Data Ingestion Points
groups.description: Represents various external origins from which data can be loaded into DSPy datasets.

groups.label: External Libraries & Environments
groups.title: Dependencies & Interactions
groups.description: External systems and libraries that the datasets module integrates with for data provision or evaluation.
